name: ALPLA
old_description: Specializes in custom HDPE packaging for home and personal care
about:
ALPLA, headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, is a family-owned plastic packaging manufacturer with a history spanning over 70 years. The company operates 17 high-capacity plants across the United States, including facilities in Jefferson City, Missouri, and Bowling Green, Kentucky, and more than 200 sites globally.

The company produces custom and standardized bottles, closures, and containers for home care, personal care, and industrial applications. Its capabilities include injection molding, large-volume bottle production with dual-neck options, decoration services for private-label and white-label packaging, and in-house testing for sealing, filling, and stacking performance. Plants are equipped for efficient mold and color changeovers, supporting flexible capacities from small runs to large-scale orders.

ALPLA serves brands in home care, personal care, and industrial sectors that require sustainable packaging solutions such as PET, HDPE, rPET, and post-consumer resin (PCR). Customers include companies seeking to localize supply chains, reduce transportation emissions, and accelerate time-to-market through standard designs that eliminate development delays.

The company emphasizes its family-owned heritage, quality and service excellence, and a localized production model that leverages a global network of over 200 facilities. It offers a CO2 reduction calculator to quantify environmental benefits and positions its standard packaging as ready-to-fill, customizable through decoration, color, and closure choices.
